Sofia — thanks for the questions. Attached is a concise estimate that covers the three tiers we discussed (Dev / Prod / Enterprise) and explicitly calls out SAML SSO and per-tenant retention as included items for the Enterprise tier. Headline notes: 

- Estimated monthly (6M tokens): Dev = $1.2k–$1.8k; Prod = $6.5k–$8.0k; Enterprise = $12k–$16k (these account for expected batching and KV cache savings).
- SAML SSO: supported in Private and Dedicated deployments; included in Enterprise pricing and requires a short SSO setup call.
- Retention policies: configurable per-tenant in Private + Dedicated; Hosted API supports account-level retention controls for Enterprise customers.

Attachments: Redwood_Estimate_BrightLane_20270903.pdf (pdf)
